Volume 32, Number 12—December 2026 Research Letter Serologic Evidence of Avian Influenza Virus Exposure in Livestock, Egypt, 2024–2026 Suggested citation for this article Abstract Spillover of influenza A(H5N1) virus to cattle in the United States sparked global concern. We investigated whether endemic avian influenza viruses are potentially spilling over into domestic livestock in Egypt. We detected influenza H9N2 antibodies in 2.5% and H5N1 antibodies in 2.9%–4.5% of tested animals. Additional surveillance will elucidate host infection dynamics. The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) clade 2.3.4.4b virus in dairy cattle in the United States represented a major shift in influenza virus ecology, marking the first sustained transmission of H5N1 virus in a mammalian livestock species (1). Genotype B3.13 was reported in dairy cows in early 2024 in several US states; data indicated a spillover event from wild birds to cattle and then interstate transmission through cow movement (1). A defining feature of H5N1 virus infection in dairy cattle is its marked tropism for the mammary gland, resulting in extremely high viral titers in milk and relatively lower viral loads in respiratory samples (2). Mechanical transmission via the milking process is believed to play a major role in cow-to-cow transmission, particularly in large dairy operations. Cow infection was not limited to genotype B3.13; European genotype euDG was shown to be able to cause infection in an experimental setting (3), and North American genotype D1.1 was detected in cattle in the United States (3). Infection of other livestock species, including goats, sheep, swine, and alpacas, was reported in mixed-species backyards and farms in the United States and United Kingdom (4,5). In 2026, a farm in the Netherlands had a cat infected with H5N1 virus; a cow at that farm had antibodies against the virus (6). Clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 virus and low-pathogenicity avian influenza A(H9N2) virus are widely and endemically circulating in poultry in Egypt on farms and backyards and at live bird markets (7). Subtype H5N1 was detected in feral rats in poultry production areas (8). In addition, reassortment events between the H5N1 and H9N2 subtypes led to the emergence of novel clade 2.3.4.4b influenza A(H5N2) viruses (9). To determine whether those viruses are spilling over to livestock in Egypt, particularly in mixed-species settings, we conducted a serosurveillance study in northern Egypt. During October 2024–January 2026, we collected 444 serum samples from 33 conveniently selected small farms (≈10 cattle, no mixed species) and backyards housing cattle (1–3 cattle with mixed species) in 3 governorates (n = 155, n = 59, and n = 230) in northern Egypt, representing common practices in Egypt. Sheep and goats were also sampled if housed in the same backyards as cattle. All sampled animals were apparently healthy adults. We tested serum samples for antibodies against a 2025 Egyptian clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 (A/duck/Egypt/BA20361C/2022) virus using hemagglutination inhibition (HI) and microneutralization (MN) assays and against a G1-like Egypt influenza A(H9N2) (A/chicken/Egypt/RA20191OP/2022) virus by HI in accordance with World Health Organization protocols (10). We considered an antibody titer >1:40 as positive for both assays. Data on the number of cows, presence of other mammals (e.g., donkeys and horses), and presence of avian species (poultry and/or wild birds) were available for 271 samples. We performed statistical comparisons with χ2 or Fisher exact tests; we considered p<0.05 statistically significant. Overall, 11 (2.5%) serum specimens tested positive for influenza A(H9N2) antibodies, 20 (4.5%) were positive for influenza A(H5N1) antibodies by HI, and 13 (2.9%) were positive for influenza A(H5N1) antibodies by MN (Figure, panel A). Positive titers were 40–160 (Figure, panel B). None of the samples tested positive for antibodies against both viruses. Of the 20 H5N1 virus specimens positive by HI, 12 tested positive by MN; 1 specimen was negative by HI and positive by MN. All influenza H9N2-positive specimens were from 3 locations in the same governorate (p = 0.005). Influenza A(H5N1) antibodies were detected in 2 governorates; the differences in detection rates by governorate were statistically significant (0%, 1.3%, and 4.8%; p = 0.049). All H5N1 virus–seropositive specimens were from cattle (Table). We detected H9N2 antibodies in 6/374 (1.6%) of cattle specimens, 1/31 (3.2%) of goat specimens, and 4/39 (10.3%) of sheep specimens (p = 0.004). Presence of other animals did not predict seropositivity. Small farms had a significantly higher proportion of H5N1 virus–positive animals tested by MN (p = 0.039). Our findings indicate that spillover of avian influenza viruses to cattle and other livestock is not geographically restricted or caused by certain genotypes of H5N1 virus. Clade 2.3.4.4b H5N1 virus of the EA-2021-AB genotype and G1-like H9N2 virus appear to be spilling over into livestock in Egypt; however, because our evidence is serologic, we could not ascertain whether true infection is occurring and whether the same signs seen in the United States are common in cattle in Egypt. Even so, the evidence is a strong indicator that spillover is occurring, similar to that reported in Europe (4,6). Furthermore, spillover is not restricted to cattle; some sheep and goats tested in our study were seropositive for influenza A(H9N2) virus. Surveillance for avian influenza viruses in Egypt and other countries, especially those in which avian influenza is endemic, will verify infection and provide data on frequency, routes of transmission, and factors affecting infection of and transmission to livestock. Dr. Gomaa is a virologist at the National Research Centre, Giza, and a member of the Center of Scientific Excellence for virus research. His work focuses on emerging and reemerging viruses, avian influenza, coronaviruses, vaccine development, viral immunology, and pandemic preparedness. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether endemic avian influenza viruses are spilling over into domestic livestock in Egypt, addressing concerns about the potential for avian influenza virus transmission to mammals.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A serosurveillance study was conducted in northern Egypt from October 2024 to January 2026, collecting 444 serum samples from 33 small farms and backyards with cattle, some of which housed mixed species. The study included 3 governorates with varying numbers of samples.
analysis.methods: Serum samples were tested for antibodies against H5N1 and H9N2 avian influenza viruses using hemagglutination inhibition (HI) and microneutralization (MN) assays following World Health Organization protocols. Serosurveillance was conducted from October 2024 to January 2026 across 33 small farms and backyards in 3 northern Egyptian governorates, collecting 444 serum samples. Antibodies against H5N1 were detected in 2.9%–4.5% of animals, while H9N2 antibodies were found in 2.5%. papers.title: ENVIRONMENTAL BIOSURVEILLANCE IN COMMERCIAL POULTRY Beyond clinical signs: the case for continuous environmental biosurveillance in commercial poultry production
papers.abstract: Commercial poultry production in the United States is threatened by infectious disease, with highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) H5N1 alone responsible for the destruction of more than 206 million birds and more than $1.4 billion in federal outbreak response and indemnity costs since 2022. Despite the scale of these losses, disease detection in commercial operations generally remains reactive, relying on the recognition of clinical signs, increased mortality, and production declines before diagnostic testing is initiated. This delay in diagnosis also creates an unnecessary urgency to begin treatment, leading some operators to apply blanket treatments before diagnostic results have been returned. Transitioning to proactive biosurveillance presents a promising alternative but introduces two new fundamental challenges: which individual birds should be selected for sampling from largely asymptomatic flocks, and which pathogens should be targeted for testing? Environmental sampling approaches—including drag swabs, litter grab samples, boot sock swabs, air samples, and water samples —offer one solution to the first challenge by aggregating pathogen shedding signals from an entire production unit into a single composite sample. While multiplexed PCR and metagenomics methods offer target-agnostic approaches to the second challenge by simultaneously characterizing some or all of the diversity of microbial taxa present in a sample without prior specification of which organisms may be causal. The objective of this review is to present (1) current flock health monitoring practices, (2) the promise and limitations of continuous environmental surveillance, (3) the range of environmental sample types available for poultry barns, and (4) how emerging multi-target testing approaches may address the lack of symptomatic guidance for what pathogens should be assessed. Together, this information represents a scientifically grounded path toward shifting commercial flock health management from reactive disease control to proactive prevention, though significant technical and operational work remains before routine commercial deployment is feasible.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了商业家禽生产中改进疾病检测的需求,强调了 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) H5N1 等传染病所构成的威胁,该疾病自 2022 年以来已造成重大经济损失和禽类 死亡率。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究回顾了目前鸡群健康监测的做法,并评估了商业家禽环境中持续环境生物监测的潜力,重点关注选择鸡只进行采样和识别大部分无症状鸡群中病原体的挑战。
elements_zh.methods: 作者讨论了环境采样技术,例如拖拭子、垃圾抓取样本、靴袜拭子、空气样本和水样,以及用于在没有事先确定病原体的情况下表征微生物多样性的多重 PCR 和宏基因组学方法。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究报告称,商业家禽养殖中的疾病检测通常是反应性的,依赖于临床症状、死亡率 和产量下降,这会延迟 诊断 并导致过早做出 死亡率 决策。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,环境生物监测为应对这些挑战提供了一种有前途的方法,但他们指出,在商业环境中常规实施还需要开展大量的技术和操作工作。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,采取主动的环境生物监测可以加强对 禽流感 和其他病原体的早期检测,支持在家禽生产中采取更有效的疾病预防策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于对当前实践的回顾,并且不提供原始数据,但它为商业家禽经营中转向主动疾病管理提供了有科学依据的理由。

papers.title: Mallard super-shedders of avian influenza exhibit distinct cloacal microbial abundance profiles
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT In many infectious disease systems, a small fraction of hosts accounts for a disproportionate share of transmission, but the biological basis of this heterogeneity remains poorly resolved. In avian influenza, mallards show substantial variation in viral shedding, raising the possibility that only a subset of individuals contributes strongly to environmental contamination and onward spread. To examine whether host microbiome structure is associated with this variation, we experimentally infected wild, captive mallards with low-pathogenic avian influenza virus. We characterized cloacal microbiomes across control, low-shedding, and high-shedding birds using shotgun metagenomic sequencing combined with read-based taxonomic profiling and co-assembled metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) reconstruction. Although infected and uninfected birds were highly similar in species presence-absence, abundance-based analyses showed clear differences in shared taxa, particularly in high-shedding birds relative to controls. Differentially abundant taxa were dominated by taxa that belonged to groups that include host-associated opportunists, consistent with compositional imbalance rather than complete community restructuring. The phylum Pseudomonadota, especially the families Enterobacteriaceae and Moraxellaceae, is well represented. Together, these findings suggest that avian influenza infection is associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in species membership and that microbiome structure is associated with heterogeneity in shedding in a key wildlife reservoir. IMPORTANCE A small fraction of infected hosts often accounts for a disproportionate share of pathogen shedding, but the biological factors underlying this variation remain poorly understood. In experimentally infected mallards, a key wildlife reservoir for avian influenza A viruses, we found that high viral shedding was associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in microbial species membership. These results suggest that host-associated microbiome structure may be linked to shedding heterogeneity and could help explain why some individuals contribute more strongly to environmental contamination and onward transmission.

papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT In many infectious disease systems, a small fraction of hosts accounts for a disproportionate share of transmission, but the biological basis of this heterogeneity remains poorly resolved. In avian influenza, mallards show substantial variation in viral shedding, raising the possibility that only a subset of individuals contributes strongly to environmental contamination and onward spread. To examine whether host microbiome structure is associated with this variation, we experimentally infected wild, captive mallards with low-pathogenic avian influenza virus. We characterized cloacal microbiomes across control, low-shedding, and high-shedding birds using shotgun metagenomic sequencing combined with read-based taxonomic profiling and co-assembled metagenome-assembled genome (MAG) reconstruction. Although infected and uninfected birds were highly similar in species presence-absence, abundance-based analyses showed clear differences in shared taxa, particularly in high-shedding birds relative to controls. Differentially abundant taxa were dominated by taxa that belonged to groups that include host-associated opportunists, consistent with compositional imbalance rather than complete community restructuring. The phylum Pseudomonadota, especially the families Enterobacteriaceae and Moraxellaceae, is well represented. Together, these findings suggest that avian influenza infection is associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in species membership and that microbiome structure is associated with heterogeneity in shedding in a key wildlife reservoir. IMPORTANCE A small fraction of infected hosts often accounts for a disproportionate share of pathogen shedding, but the biological factors underlying this variation remain poorly understood. In experimentally infected mallards, a key wildlife reservoir for avian influenza A viruses, we found that high viral shedding was associated with shifts in the abundance of cloacal bacterial taxa rather than broad changes in microbial species membership. These results suggest that host-associated microbiome structure may be linked to shedding heterogeneity and could help explain why some individuals contribute more strongly to environmental contamination and onward transmission.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 在许多传染病系统中,宿主 的一小部分占 传播 的不成比例的份额,但这种异质性的生物学基础仍然没有得到很好的解决。在 禽流感 中,野鸭在病毒脱落方面表现出巨大差异,这增加了只有一小部分个体对环境污染和进一步传播做出重大贡献的可能性。为了检查 宿主 微生物组结构是否与这种变异相关,我们通过实验用低致病性 禽流感 病毒感染野生圈养野鸭。我们使用鸟枪法宏基因组测序结合基于读取的分类学分析和共组装宏基因组组装 基因组 (MAG) 重建,对对照、低脱落和高脱落鸟类的泄殖腔微生物组进行了表征。尽管受感染和未受感染的鸟类在物种存在与不存在方面高度相似,但基于丰度的分析显示,共享类群存在明显差异,特别是相对于对照组而言,高脱落鸟类。差异丰富的类群以属于包括 宿主 相关机会主义者在内的群体的类群为主,这与组成不平衡而不是完全的群落重组一致。假单胞菌门,特别是肠杆菌科和莫拉菌科,有很好的代表性。总之,这些发现表明,禽流感 感染与泄殖腔细菌类群丰度的变化有关,而不是物种成员的广泛变化,并且微生物组结构与关键野生动物 储存宿主 脱落的异质性有关。重要性 一小部分受感染的 宿主 通常导致病原体脱落的比例不成比例,但这种变异背后的生物学因素仍然知之甚少。在实验感染的野鸭(储存宿主 禽流感 A 病毒的一种重要野生动物)中,我们发现大量病毒脱落与泄殖腔细菌类群丰度的变化有关,而不是与微生物物种成员的广泛变化有关。这些结果表明,宿主 相关的微生物组结构可能与脱落异质性有关,并有助于解释为什么某些个体对环境污染和 传播 的影响更大。

papers.title: DNA triangular prism-engineered multicolor chemiluminescence capsules for multiplexed visual detection of nucleic acid biomarkers.
papers.abstract: Chemiluminescence (CL) capsules, featuring long-lasting emission and facile functionalization, hold great potential for multiplexed analysis of nucleic acid biomarkers. Herein, we report a strategy that utilizes DNA triangular prism (TP) scaffolds to spatially engineer trivalent catalytic hairpin assembly (CHA) amplification on multicolor CL capsules for the multiplexed visual detection of avian influenza virus (AIV) DNA biomarkers. Three multicolor CL capsules are fabricated by co-encapsulating luminol alone, luminol with coumarin 6 (C6), and luminol with both C6 and Nile red (NR), denoted as LUM@TP-3H2, C6/LUM@TP-3H4, and NR/C6/LUM@TP-3H6. TP-3DNAzyme exhibits approximately 1.6-fold higher peroxidase-like activity than free DNAzyme in solution, and TP-functionalized capsules show stronger CL signals and higher CL amplification efficiency than capsules with directly anchored CHA hairpins. Upon target-triggered CHA reaction and H2O2 addition, these TP-functionalized capsules generate blue, green, and red light, respectively, through chemiluminescence resonance energy transfer (CRET), along with an intense and long-lasting CL emission over 1200 s. The capsule-based CL imaging assay is recorded with a common smartphone, exhibiting a linear range of 10-1000 pM and detection limits of 0.57 pM, 0.82 pM, and 1.97 pM for H1N1, H5N1, and H7N9, respectively, with recoveries of 97.41-104.87% in 100-fold diluted human serum. Altogether, this work provides a versatile CRET platform by using TP-engineered multicolor capsules with trivalent CHA amplification for smartphone-based multiplexed visual detection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a novel method for the multiplexed visual detection of nucleic acid biomarkers, particularly for avian influenza virus (AIV) DNA, leveraging the unique properties of chemiluminescence (CL) capsules and DNA triangular prism (TP) scaffolds.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the fabrication of three multicolor CL capsules using DNA triangular prism scaffolds and tested their performance for the detection of AIV DNA biomarkers, including specific subtypes such as H5N1 and H7N9.
analysis.methods: The researchers designed a CL imaging assay using TP-engineered multicolor capsules with trivalent catalytic hairpin assembly (CHA) amplification, where CL signals were generated through chemiluminescence resonance energy transfer (CRET) upon target-triggered reactions.
analysis.main_results: TP-functionalized capsules demonstrated stronger CL signals and higher amplification efficiency compared to capsules with directly anchored CHA hairpins, with detection limits of 0.57 pM, 0.82 pM, and 1.97 pM for H1N1, H5N1, and H7N9, respectively.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the TP-engineered multicolor CL capsules offer a versatile platform for smartphone-based multiplexed visual detection of AIV DNA biomarkers, enhancing the sensitivity and specificity of diagnostic methods.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This method could improve the surveillance and diagnosis of avian influenza A viruses, particularly in resource-limited settings, by enabling rapid, visual, and sensitive detection of multiple viral subtypes using a smartphone.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a novel method for the multiplexed visual detection of avian influenza virus (AIV) DNA biomarkers using DNA triangular prism (TP)-engineered multicolor chemiluminescence (CL) capsules. The researchers fabricated three CL capsules with varying compositions and tested their performance for detecting specific AIV subtypes, including H5N1 and H7N9. The TP-functionalized capsules showed enhanced CL signals and amplification efficiency compared to traditional methods. The results indicate that this platform could offer a sensitive and versatile tool for AIV detection, particularly in low-resource environments. However, the study is based solely on abstract-level reporting, which limits the confidence in the findings. The method leverages chemiluminescence resonance energy transfer (CRET) and trivalent catalytic hairpin assembly (CHA) to generate distinct colors for different viral subtypes, enabling visual identification without complex instrumentation. The study highlights the potential of this approach for improving surveillance and diagnosis of AIV, but further validation in real-world settings is needed.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a novel method for the multiplexed visual detection of nucleic acid biomarkers, particularly for avian influenza virus (AIV) DNA, leveraging the unique properties of chemiluminescence (CL) capsules and DNA triangular prism (TP) scaffolds.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved the fabrication of three multicolor CL capsules using DNA triangular prism scaffolds and tested their performance for the detection of AIV DNA biomarkers, including specific subtypes such as H5N1 and H7N9.
elements_en.methods: The researchers designed a CL imaging assay using TP-engineered multicolor capsules with trivalent catalytic hairpin assembly (CHA) amplification, where CL signals were generated through chemiluminescence resonance energy transfer (CRET) upon target-triggered reactions.
elements_en.main_results: TP-functionalized capsules demonstrated stronger CL signals and higher amplification efficiency compared to capsules with directly anchored CHA hairpins, with detection limits of 0.57 pM, 0.82 pM, and 1.97 pM for H1N1, H5N1, and H7N9, respectively.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the TP-engineered multicolor CL capsules offer a versatile platform for smartphone-based multiplexed visual detection of AIV DNA biomarkers, enhancing the sensitivity and specificity of diagnostic methods.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This method could improve the surveillance and diagnosis of avian influenza A viruses, particularly in resource-limited settings, by enabling rapid, visual, and sensitive detection of multiple viral subtypes using a smartphone.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level reporting, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of detailed experimental data and validation in real-world clinical or field settings.

papers.title_zh: DNA 三棱柱设计的多色化学发光胶囊,用于核酸生物标志物的多重视觉检测。
papers.source_body_en: Chemiluminescence (CL) capsules, featuring long-lasting emission and facile functionalization, hold great potential for multiplexed analysis of nucleic acid biomarkers. Herein, we report a strategy that utilizes DNA triangular prism (TP) scaffolds to spatially engineer trivalent catalytic hairpin assembly (CHA) amplification on multicolor CL capsules for the multiplexed visual detection of avian influenza virus (AIV) DNA biomarkers. Three multicolor CL capsules are fabricated by co-encapsulating luminol alone, luminol with coumarin 6 (C6), and luminol with both C6 and Nile red (NR), denoted as LUM@TP-3H2, C6/LUM@TP-3H4, and NR/C6/LUM@TP-3H6. TP-3DNAzyme exhibits approximately 1.6-fold higher peroxidase-like activity than free DNAzyme in solution, and TP-functionalized capsules show stronger CL signals and higher CL amplification efficiency than capsules with directly anchored CHA hairpins. Upon target-triggered CHA reaction and H2O2 addition, these TP-functionalized capsules generate blue, green, and red light, respectively, through chemiluminescence resonance energy transfer (CRET), along with an intense and long-lasting CL emission over 1200 s. The capsule-based CL imaging assay is recorded with a common smartphone, exhibiting a linear range of 10-1000 pM and detection limits of 0.57 pM, 0.82 pM, and 1.97 pM for H1N1, H5N1, and H7N9, respectively, with recoveries of 97.41-104.87% in 100-fold diluted human serum. Altogether, this work provides a versatile CRET platform by using TP-engineered multicolor capsules with trivalent CHA amplification for smartphone-based multiplexed visual detection.
papers.abstract_zh: 化学发光(CL)胶囊具有持久发射和易于功能化的特点,在核酸生物标志物的多重分析中具有巨大的潜力。在此,我们报告了一种利用 DNA 三棱柱 (TP) 支架在多色 CL 胶囊上空间设计三价催化发夹组装 (CHA) 扩增的策略,用于 禽流感 病毒 (AIV) DNA 生物标志物的多重视觉检测。通过单独共封装鲁米诺、鲁米诺与香豆素 6 (C6)、鲁米诺与 C6 和尼罗红 (NR) 共封装,制备了三种多色 CL 胶囊,分别表示为 LUM@TP-3H2、C6/LUM@TP-3H4 和 NR/C6/LUM@TP-3H6。TP-3DNAzyme 的过氧化物酶样活性比溶液中的游离 DNAzyme 高约 1.6 倍,并且 TP 功能化胶囊比直接锚定 CHA 发夹的胶囊显示出更强的 CL 信号和更高的 CL 扩增效率。在目标触发 CHA 反应和添加 H2O2 后,这些 TP 功能化胶囊通过化学发光共振能量转移 (CRET) 分别产生蓝光、绿光和红光,并发出超过 1200 秒的强烈而持久的 CL 发射。基于胶囊的 CL 成像测定是用普通智能手机记录的,对 H1N1、H5N1 和 H7N9 的线性范围为 10-1000 pM,检测限分别为 0.57 pM、0.82 pM 和 1.97 pM,在 100 倍稀释的人血清中回收率为 97.41-104.87%。总而言之,这项工作通过使用 TP 设计的多色胶囊和三价 CHA 扩增,为基于智能手机的多重视觉检测提供了一个多功能的 CRET 平台。

papers.title: Awareness, attitude and adoption of avian influenza biosecurity practices among smallholder poultry farmers
papers.abstract: Avian influenza remains an important threat to poultry production and farmers’ livelihoods, particularly in smallholder systems where biosecurity practices are often limited. The present study assessed farmers’ awareness, attitude and adoption of recommended avian influenza biosecurity practices and examined their association with selected socioeconomic characteristics. The study was conducted during 2019-20 in 14 villages covering all seven blocks of Jabalpur district, Madhya Pradesh. A total of 140 smallholder poultry farmers keeping fewer than 100 birds were selected through multistage sampling and interviewed using structured schedules. Awareness was assessed using a 25-item schedule, attitude using an adopted 14-item scale, and adoption using a 43-item schedule covering five biosecurity domains. Data were analyzed using frequency, percentage, correlation and multiple regression. The findings showed that 60.71% of farmers had low awareness, while only 12.86% had high awareness. Very low attitude scores were observed among 54.29% of farmers. Overall, most farmers (82.86%) had very low adoption of the recommended biosecurity practices, while only 1.42% showed a high level of adoption. Awareness and attitude were positively associated with adoption. The findings highlight the need for practical training, accessible veterinary extension services and locally relevant communication to help farmers improve biosecurity practices at the farm level.
papers.journal: International Journal of Agriculture Extension and Social Development

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the awareness, attitude, and adoption of avian influenza biosecurity practices among smallholder poultry farmers in Jabalpur district, Madhya Pradesh, during 2019-20. Using structured schedules, the researchers assessed these factors and found that a majority of farmers had low awareness and attitude, with very low adoption of recommended practices. Awareness and attitude were positively correlated with adoption. The study emphasizes the need for targeted interventions such as training and improved communication to enhance biosecurity practices. The findings are based on a survey of 140 farmers and do not include detailed limitations or evidence strength assessments.

Awareness and attitude were positively associated with adoption. The findings highlight the need for practical training, accessible veterinary extension services and locally relevant communication to help farmers improve biosecurity practices at the farm level.

papers.title: The Psychological Impacts of Avian Influenza
papers.abstract: Psychological factors have been neglected in preparation guidelines for an avian influenza (AVI) pandemic. To address this gap, a narrative literature review was conducted to (1) examine how AVI outbreaks—so far largely contained to livestock—have psychologically impacted people, and (2) consider the implications if an AVI pandemic were to emerge, in which large numbers of people would be infected. Findings indicate that AVI outbreaks have been characterized by fear, disgust, and avoidance of poultry products. Many of the other psychological phenomena observed in AVI outbreaks have been documented in past pandemics and other infectious outbreaks: Blame and anger, disease-related avoidance and stigmatization, xenophobia, conspiracy theories, panic buying, and personal stockpiling have all arisen in response to AVI outbreaks. These psychological phenomena may persist and intensify if AVI outbreaks evolve into a pandemic. The lessons learned from COVID-19 can be used to prepare for a possible AVI pandemic. However, additional measures may be needed. Fear, disgust, and avoidance of specific foods would likely distinguish an AVI pandemic from COVID-19. The threat of infected food triggers disgust, and so food-related disgust would likely be a prominent emotional reaction during an AVI pandemic. Public messaging from health authorities and others has the potential to either ease or exacerbate public concerns about food safety, depending on how the messages are crafted.

papers.title: Probiotics as a Strategy for Mitigating Viral Infections in Poultry: Immunomodulatory Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potential.
papers.abstract: Poultry viral infections remain a persistent challenge for the poultry industry, causing significant economic losses and posing potential threats to human health. The escalating frequency of outbreaks involving pathogens, such as infectious bronchitis virus (IBV), Newcastle disease virus (NDV) and avian influenza virus (AIV), underscores the urgent need for effective interventions. Probiotics have gained attention as a promising strategy to combat these viral infections due to their potential in enhancing immune responses and establishing a healthy gut microbiome. A literature search was carried out on Google Scholar, Scopus and PubMed using key search terms, such as 'probiotics', 'Lactobacillus', 'acidophilus', 'poultry', 'viral infections', 'Newcastle Disease Virus (NDV)' and other relevant terms. Inclusion criteria for manuscripts used were based on the relevance to probiotic-based interventions in poultry, the focus on immunological mechanisms and the examination of viral pathogens commonly found in West African poultry farming systems. This review explores the role of probiotics in mitigating the effects of NDV, AIV and IBV in poultry, focusing on their immunomodulatory effects and antiviral mechanisms. Lactobacillus acidophilus, L. plantarum have shown an interesting promise in countering NDV infections by modulating immunological parameters and enhancing antibody responses. Similarly, these probiotics have exhibited antiviral activity against AIV, promoting immune activation and reducing viral loads. plantarum have emerged as potential adjuvants for IBV vaccines, improving antibody responses and humoural immunity.

papers.title_original: Probiotics as a Strategy for Mitigating Viral Infections in Poultry: Immunomodulatory Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potential.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the use of probiotics to mitigate viral infections in poultry, particularly avian influenza A viruses, by examining their immunomodulatory effects and antiviral mechanisms. The central question is whether probiotics can serve as an effective strategy for reducing the impact of these viruses on poultry health and potentially human health through zoonotic transmission.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review conducted a literature search on Google Scholar, Scopus, and PubMed using terms like 'probiotics', 'Lactobacillus', 'acidophilus', 'poultry', 'viral infections', 'Newcastle Disease Virus (NDV)', and other relevant terms. Inclusion criteria were based on the relevance to probiotic-based interventions in poultry, the focus on immunological mechanisms, and the examination of viral pathogens common in West African poultry farming systems.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Probiotics, particularly Lactobacillus acidophilus and Lactobacillus plantarum, have shown potential in modulating immunological parameters, enhancing antibody responses, and reducing viral loads against avian influenza A viruses (AIV). These findings suggest that probiotics may be a viable strategy for improving immune defenses against AIV in poultry.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the need for more targeted studies on probiotics' effects against specific avian influenza subtypes, such as H5N1 and H5N6. There is limited evidence on the long-term efficacy of probiotics in preventing zoonotic transmission of AIV to humans, and further research is required to address these gaps.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Future research should prioritize investigating the efficacy of probiotics against specific avian influenza subtypes and their role in preventing zoonotic transmission. Practical applications may include integrating probiotics into poultry farming practices to enhance immune responses and reduce the economic and public health burden of AIV outbreaks.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the potential of probiotics, particularly Lactobacillus acidophilus and Lactobacillus plantarum, in mitigating avian influenza A virus (AIV) infections in poultry. It highlights their immunomodulatory effects and antiviral properties, suggesting they may enhance immune defenses and reduce viral loads. However, the review identifies gaps in understanding the long-term efficacy of probiotics against specific AIV subtypes and their role in zoonotic transmission. The findings support further research into targeted probiotic interventions and their integration into poultry farming practices to improve health outcomes and reduce economic losses associated with AIV outbreaks.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述的重点是通过检查益生菌的免疫调节作用和 抗病毒药物 机制,使用益生菌减轻家禽病毒感染,特别是 禽流感 A 病毒。核心问题是益生菌是否可以作为一种有效策略,通过人畜共患 传播 来减少这些病毒对家禽健康和潜在人类健康的影响。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述使用“益生菌”、“乳杆菌”、“嗜酸菌”、“家禽”、“病毒感染”、“新城疫病毒 (NDV)”等术语和其他相关术语在 Google Scholar、Scopus 和 PubMed 上进行了文献检索。纳入标准基于与家禽益生菌干预措施的相关性、对免疫机制的关注以及对西非家禽养殖系统中常见病毒病原体的检查。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 益生菌,特别是嗜酸乳杆菌和植物乳杆菌,已显示出调节免疫参数、增强抗体反应和减少针对 禽流感 A 病毒 (AIV) 的病毒载量的潜力。这些发现表明,益生菌可能是改善家禽 AIV 免疫防御的可行策略。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调需要对益生菌针对特定 禽流感 亚型(例如 H5N1 和 H5N6)的作用进行更有针对性的研究。关于益生菌在预防人类 AIV 人畜共患 传播 方面的长期功效的证据有限,需要进一步研究来解决这些差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 未来的研究应优先研究益生菌对特定 禽流感 亚型的功效及其在预防人畜共患 传播 中的作用。实际应用可能包括将益生菌融入家禽养殖实践中,以增强 免疫应答 并减少 AIV 暴发 的经济和公共卫生负担。

papers.abstract_zh: 禽类病毒感染仍然是禽类养殖业中的持续挑战,导致显著的经济损失并可能对人类健康构成潜在威胁。涉及病原体的病毒感染频率不断上升,例如传染性支气管炎病毒(IBV)、新城疫病毒(NDV)和禽流感病毒(AIV),凸显了对有效干预措施的迫切需求。由于益生菌在增强免疫应答和建立健康肠道微生物群方面具有潜力,它们已成为一种有前景的策略,用于对抗这些病毒感染。通过在Google Scholar、Scopus和PubMed上使用关键搜索词,如'益生菌'、'乳酸杆菌'、'嗜酸乳杆菌'、'禽类'、'病毒感染'、'新城疫病毒(NDV)'及其他相关术语进行了文献检索。所选文献的纳入标准基于其与禽类益生菌干预措施的相关性、对免疫机制的关注以及对西非禽类养殖系统中常见病毒病原体的分析。本综述探讨了益生菌在减轻NDV、AIV和IBV对禽类影响中的作用,重点在于其免疫调节效应和抗病毒机制。嗜酸乳杆菌(Lactobacillus acidophilus)和植物乳杆菌(L. plantarum)在调节免疫参数和增强抗体反应方面显示出对抗NDV感染的有趣前景。同样,这些益生菌在对抗AIV方面也表现出抗病毒活性,促进免疫激活并降低病毒载量。植物乳杆菌在应对IBV病毒感染方面已显示出潜在的辅助作用,改善抗体反应和体液免疫。

papers.abstract: The Izumi Plain, Japan, is a major wintering site for endangered cranes adjacent to intensive poultry production, creating an important interface for avian influenza virus (AIV) surveillance. This Review synthesizes more than a decade of environmental and wild-bird surveillance, focusing on water collected from artificial crane roosts. Initially, virus isolation from roost water was inefficient, yielding few isolates. A modified procedure introduced in the 2018/19 season markedly improved isolation efficiency, yielding 44 low pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (LPAIVs) that season. The increased availability of infectious isolates enabled whole-genome analyses that revealed subtype diversity, reassortment, and genotype turnover, transforming roost-water surveillance from sporadic detection into a tool for characterizing AIV circulation. During the 2022/23 high pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) outbreak, extensive crane mortality contrasted with limited HPAIV isolation from roost water, highlighting the limitations of environmental surveillance alone. Integrating environmental, host-based, serological, and genomic data provides a more comprehensive understanding of HPAIV dynamics and strengthens surveillance at high-density wild-bird aggregation sites.

analysis.summary_en: This review examines avian influenza A viruses (AIVs) in the context of crane wintering in the Izumi Plain, Japan, which serves as an interface for AIV surveillance due to its proximity to poultry production. The review synthesizes over a decade of environmental and wild-bird surveillance data, emphasizing the role of water from artificial crane roosts. Initially, virus isolation from roost water was inefficient, but a modified procedure introduced in the 2018/19 season improved isolation efficiency, enabling the identification of 44 low pathogenicity avian influenza viruses (LPAIVs). elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注在日本泉平原(毗邻家禽生产区)越冬的鹤中的 禽流感 A 病毒 (AIV) 及其 监测。核心问题是人工鹤栖息地的水环境 监测 如何有助于了解 AIV 循环和动态。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该评论综合了十多年的环境和野生鸟类 监测 数据,特别是从人工鹤栖息地收集的水。这些方法包括病毒分离、2018/19赛季引入的修改程序以及用于表征AIV循环的全基因组分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 修改后的程序显着提高了病毒分离效率,导致2018/19赛季鉴定出44种低致病性禽流感病毒(LPAIV)。全 基因组 分析揭示了亚型多样性、重配和基因型更新,将栖息水 基因组 转变为表征 AIV 循环的工具。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 在 2022/23 HPAI 暴发 期间,观察到了大量起重机 死亡率,但检测到 HPAIV 与栖息水的分离有限,突出了环境 监测 的局限性。需要集成多个数据源以更好地了解 HPAIV 动态。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 建议整合环境、基于 宿主 的血清学和基因组数据,以更全面地了解 HPAIV 动态,并加强高密度野鸟聚集地的 监测。

papers.title: Bovine-Associated Viruses at the Human–Animal Interface: Zoonotic Risks, Spillover Dynamics, and One Health Implications
papers.abstract: Cattle serve as critical ecological reservoirs and amplifying hosts for numerous zoonotic viruses, thereby playing a central role in their maintenance, evolution, and interspecies transmission. Here, we briefly evaluate six viral pathogens of significant public health relevance linked to cattle, namely cowpox virus, bovine coronavirus, influenza A virus (H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b), bovine rotavirus, bovine leukemia virus, and SARS-CoV-2. This review focuses on advances in viral characterization, host tropism, and the mechanisms that may facilitate spillover through routes such as direct contact, environmental exposure, and foodborne transmission. It further highlights the bidirectional nature of pathogen exchange at the human-animal interface, where cattle may act as a source of viral variants with potential public health implications, though the risk varies considerably among the viruses discussed. Moreover, we discuss the imperative for integrated surveillance and One Health interventions to mitigate these transmission risks, highlighting cattle as valuable sentinel species within global health security frameworks.

papers.title: H5N5 virus transmission is driven by repeated cross-Atlantic introductions and transmission among high latitude seabirds
papers.abstract: In November 2025, the first global H5N5 infection was reported in a person in Washington State. Previously, these viruses had only been detected in seabirds and shorebirds near the Atlantic Ocean, suggesting potentially distinct ecology from dominant H5N1 strains. Using 354 global H5N5 genomes, we show that H5N5 viruses have been carried by high latitude seabirds and shorebirds across the Atlantic at least 9 times, with introductions more frequent in the fall and spring. We reconstruct a plausible path of cross-continental movement via Arctic or sub-Arctic regions, followed by a year of cryptic circulation prior to human spillover. These data show that H5N5 viruses have undergone far more intercontinental movements than previously recognized, and exhibit host and geographic patterns that are fundamentally distinct from dominant H5N1 lineages. The distinct host ecology, geography, and movement, paired with the capacity to infect a person, suggest that enhanced surveillance may be warranted.

papers.title_zh: H5N5 病毒 传播 是由反复跨大西洋传入和高纬度海鸟中的 传播 驱动的

Previously, these viruses had only been detected in seabirds and shorebirds near the Atlantic Ocean, suggesting potentially distinct ecology from dominant H5N1 strains. Using 354 global H5N5 genomes, we show that H5N5 viruses have been carried by high latitude seabirds and shorebirds across the Atlantic at least 9 times, with introductions more frequent in the fall and spring. We reconstruct a plausible path of cross-continental movement via Arctic or sub-Arctic regions, followed by a year of cryptic circulation prior to human spillover. These data show that H5N5 viruses have undergone far more intercontinental movements than previously recognized, and exhibit host and geographic patterns that are fundamentally distinct from dominant H5N1 lineages. The distinct host ecology, geography, and movement, paired with the capacity to infect a person, suggest that enhanced surveillance may be warranted.

papers.title: Silent travelers: the potential of migratory birds and their ticks to introduce emerging viruses into Switzerland
papers.abstract: Abstract Switzerland hosts over 400 bird species, many of which are migratory. Through diverse movement patterns, ranging from short distances to almost global migrations, these birds can introduce zoonotic viruses, such as West Nile virus (WNV) or avian influenza virus (AIV), as well as unknown and potentially emerging viruses. Furthermore, they facilitate the global dispersal of infected ectoparasites, particularly ticks, risking the introduction of novel tick-borne diseases. To assess this risk, we sampled 42 bird species (39 migratory, 3 resident) over seven months in 2023 at the Bolle di Magadino nature reserve and the Piano di Magadino area in the canton Ticino (Switzerland). This region, because of its transitional climate, serves as an important resting and breeding ground for migratory birds. In total, 496 oropharyngeal-cloacal swabs, 164 sera, and 22 associated ticks were collected. While RT-qPCR of the swabs detected no active WNV or AIV infections, ELISA testing identified Orthoflavivirus antibodies in 15 of 164 sera, indicating prior exposure. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing revealed a viral landscape spanning 33 families (29 of which were identified in birds). Within this virome, DNA viruses, predominantly Circoviridae, Genomoviridae, and Parvoviridae , dominated in abundance but exhibited low diversity. In contrast, the highly diverse RNA virome primarily reflected the birds’ dietary habits and the local habitat at the nature reserve. Notably, we report the first detection of Bole tick virus 4 (BoTV4) in Switzerland, identified in several ticks ( Rhipicephalus turanicus ) associated with long-distance migrants. This member of the newly established Pestiviridae family is already established in parts of Asia, Africa, and Europe. This study provides the first active surveillance of the wild bird virome in Switzerland. Our findings establish a framework for the early detection of emerging viruses and underscore the role of migratory birds as dispersal vectors for ticks and novel tick-borne viruses.

papers.title_zh: 沉默的旅行者:候鸟及其蜱虫将新出现的病毒引入瑞士的潜力
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Switzerland hosts over 400 bird species, many of which are migratory. Through diverse movement patterns, ranging from short distances to almost global migrations, these birds can introduce zoonotic viruses, such as West Nile virus (WNV) or avian influenza virus (AIV), as well as unknown and potentially emerging viruses. Furthermore, they facilitate the global dispersal of infected ectoparasites, particularly ticks, risking the introduction of novel tick-borne diseases. To assess this risk, we sampled 42 bird species (39 migratory, 3 resident) over seven months in 2023 at the Bolle di Magadino nature reserve and the Piano di Magadino area in the canton Ticino (Switzerland). This region, because of its transitional climate, serves as an important resting and breeding ground for migratory birds. In total, 496 oropharyngeal-cloacal swabs, 164 sera, and 22 associated ticks were collected. While RT-qPCR of the swabs detected no active WNV or AIV infections, ELISA testing identified Orthoflavivirus antibodies in 15 of 164 sera, indicating prior exposure. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing revealed a viral landscape spanning 33 families (29 of which were identified in birds). Within this virome, DNA viruses, predominantly Circoviridae, Genomoviridae, and Parvoviridae , dominated in abundance but exhibited low diversity. In contrast, the highly diverse RNA virome primarily reflected the birds’ dietary habits and the local habitat at the nature reserve. Notably, we report the first detection of Bole tick virus 4 (BoTV4) in Switzerland, identified in several ticks ( Rhipicephalus turanicus ) associated with long-distance migrants. This member of the newly established Pestiviridae family is already established in parts of Asia, Africa, and Europe. This study provides the first active surveillance of the wild bird virome in Switzerland. Our findings establish a framework for the early detection of emerging viruses and underscore the role of migratory birds as dispersal vectors for ticks and novel tick-borne viruses.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 瑞士 宿主 有 400 多种鸟类,其中许多是候鸟。通过不同的运动模式,从短距离到几乎全球性的迁徙,这些鸟类可以引入人畜共患病毒,例如西尼罗河病毒(WNV)或禽流感病毒(AIV),以及未知和潜在新出现的病毒。此外,它们还促进了受感染的体外寄生虫(尤其是蜱虫)在全球的传播,从而带来了引入新型蜱传疾病的风险。为了评估这种风险,我们在 2023 年的七个月内对提契诺州(瑞士)的 Bolle di Magadino 自然保护区和 Piano di Magadino 地区的 42 种鸟类(39 种候鸟,3 种留鸟)进行了采样。该地区气候过渡,是候鸟的重要休息和繁殖地。总共收集了 496 份口咽泄殖腔拭子、164 份血清和 22 只相关蜱。虽然拭子的 RT-qPCR 没有检测到活跃的 WNV 或 AIV 感染,但 ELISA 测试在 164 份血清中的 15 份中发现了正黄病毒抗体,表明之前曾接触过。宏基因组下一代测序揭示了跨越 33 个科的病毒景观(其中 29 个科是在鸟类中发现的)。在该病毒组中,DNA病毒(主要是圆环病毒科、基因病毒科和细小病毒科)在丰度上占主导地位,但表现出较低的多样性。相比之下,高度多样化的RNA病毒组主要反映了鸟类的饮食习惯和自然保护区的当地栖息地。值得注意的是,我们报告在瑞士首次检测到伯乐蜱病毒 4 (BoTV4),该病毒在与长途迁徙有关的几种蜱 (Rhipicephalus turanicus) 中被发现。这种新建立的瘟病毒科成员已经在亚洲、非洲和欧洲的部分地区定居。这项研究提供了瑞士第一个活跃的 野生鸟类 病毒组 监测。我们的研究结果为早期检测新出现的病毒建立了一个框架,并强调了候鸟作为蜱虫和新型蜱传病毒传播 媒介 的作用。

papers.title: Defective Viral Genomes Reveal History-dependent Self-regulation of Type I Interferon Dynamics
papers.abstract: Abstract Type I interferons (IFN) help clear a viral infection, but IFN levels can then decline to reset the antiviral state and avoid innate immune dysregulation. Such dysregulation can occur following infection with highly pathogenic and pandemic RNA viruses, such as H5N1 influenza A viruses or SARS-CoV-2. In spite of the strong innate immune response that these viruses induce, pandemic viruses replicate and spread successfully, suggesting that they can circumvent the effects of IFN. Innate immune activation is triggered when host cells detect viral RNA, especially defective viral genomes (DVGs). A strong IFN response (e.g. to DVGs or a highly immunogenic wild-type infection) must then decline through negative feedback involving the IFN receptor. How DVGs modulate this feedback remains poorly understood. To quantify positive and negative IFN regulation, we first performed in vitro experiments combining different doses of viral RNA and exogenous IFN, and measured subsequent IFN expression. We next developed an in vivo Bayesian computational model that captures the impact of influenza virus DVGs on both positive and negative IFN feedback. Competition between DVGs and virus is also considered. Finally, we calibrated this model on published in vitro and in vivo influenza virus infection data. Our model suggests that the cumulative IFN exposure of a host cell, rather than the instantaneous IFN level, shapes further IFN induction; this gives DVGs a dual role: beyond triggering IFN induction, they can also lower it through negative feedback. Our model further predicts that these effects are important locally, shaping the spatial dynamics of the response, allowing suppression of innate immune responses in neighbouring, uninfected cells. Through this model, we can explain two important biological observations: i) IFN levels can decline while virus and DVG levels continue to rise in tissue culture and mouse infections; and ii) pandemic viruses that produce high levels of immunogenic RNA molecules can successfully replicate through local innate immune suppression. Overall, we propose that heterogeneity within viral populations (including DVGs and other noncanonical viral RNAs) can modulate positive and negative feedback loops and shape infection outcomes. More broadly, our work may support studies into the therapeutic use of these viral RNA populations. Author summary Humans and animals have to fight influenza virus and other infections without inducing immunopathology. After detection of an infection, the innate immune system produces type I interferon (IFN), a signal that starts a protective response. However, high levels of IFN and prolonged IFN expression can cause damage to tissues and worsen disease. Negative feedback is one route by which IFN production can stop, but its activation during viral infection remains poorly understood. A central question is why viruses can continue to replicate and spread despite a strong IFN response. We here investigated why IFN levels can begin to decline while virus levels continue to rise during influenza virus infection. This decline is most pronounced when the virus produces large amounts of defective viral genomes (DVGs). These defective genomes arise naturally during viral replication and are produced by many RNA viruses, including SARS-CoV-2, Ebola virus, and measles virus. Using cell-culture experiments, computational modelling, and fitting of our model to cell-culture and mouse data, we find that defective genomes contribute to both IFN activation and its negative feedback. Both the experiments and model support a mechanism in which IFN accumulation during infection suppresses its own production, and that this suppression can start earlier under strong DVG stimulation. At the local level, this can allow viral spread to continue even while overall IFN levels remain high. Overall, our findings reveal an additional level of interplay between defective viral genomes and the host innate immune system. They also suggest that the potential therapeutic use of defective genomes must be carefully calibrated to achieve an optimal antiviral response.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how type I interferon (IFN) dynamics are regulated during viral infections, particularly focusing on the role of defective viral genomes (DVGs) in modulating IFN responses. The background highlights that IFN levels can decline despite strong innate immune responses, which is critical for avoiding immunopathology.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study combined in vitro experiments with an in vivo Bayesian computational model to investigate the impact of influenza virus DVGs on IFN feedback. It used published in vitro and in vivo influenza virus infection data for calibration.
analysis.methods: The researchers conducted in vitro experiments with varying doses of viral RNA and exogenous IFN to measure IFN expression. They also developed a computational model to simulate the effects of DVGs on IFN feedback and calibrated it using existing infection data.
analysis.main_results: The model suggests that cumulative IFN exposure, rather than instantaneous levels, shapes further IFN induction. DVGs are shown to trigger IFN activation while also contributing to negative feedback, which can suppress innate immune responses in neighboring cells.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal a dual role of DVGs in both activating and suppressing IFN responses, offering a novel mechanism for how viruses can evade immune responses. This explains two key observations: IFN levels can decline while virus levels rise, and pandemic viruses can replicate through local immune suppression.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the complex interplay between DVGs and the host immune system, which could inform strategies for therapeutic interventions targeting viral RNA populations to optimize antiviral responses.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on in vitro and in vivo data, which may limit generalizability. However, the model is calibrated on published data, and the evidence is supported by both experimental and computational approaches, giving it a moderate confidence level.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how defective viral genomes (DVGs) influence type I interferon (IFN) dynamics during influenza virus infection. The research highlights that DVGs can both trigger IFN induction and contribute to negative feedback, allowing viruses to evade immune responses. By combining in vitro experiments with a Bayesian computational model, the authors demonstrate that cumulative IFN exposure, rather than instantaneous levels, determines further IFN production. Their findings explain why IFN levels can decline while virus levels rise and suggest that DVGs may play a role in local immune suppression, which could have implications for antiviral therapies. The study's reliance on existing data limits its generalizability, but the integration of experimental and computational methods provides a moderate level of confidence in its conclusions.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果揭示了 DVG 在激活和抑制 IFN 反应中的双重作用,为病毒如何逃避 免疫应答 提供了一种新机制。这解释了两个关键的观察结果:当病毒水平上升时,干扰素水平可能下降,大流行病毒可以通过局部免疫抑制进行复制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 DVG 和 宿主 免疫系统之间复杂相互作用的见解,这可以为针对病毒 RNA 群体的治疗干预策略提供信息,以优化 抗病毒药物 反应。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于体外和体内数据,这可能会限制普遍性。然而,该模型是根据已发布的数据进行校准的,并且证据得到实验和计算方法的支持,使其具有中等的置信度。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how type I interferon (IFN) dynamics are regulated during viral infections, particularly focusing on the role of defective viral genomes (DVGs) in modulating IFN responses. The background highlights that IFN levels can decline despite strong innate immune responses, which is critical for avoiding immunopathology.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study combined in vitro experiments with an in vivo Bayesian computational model to investigate the impact of influenza virus DVGs on IFN feedback. It used published in vitro and in vivo influenza virus infection data for calibration.
analysis_en.methods: The researchers conducted in vitro experiments with varying doses of viral RNA and exogenous IFN to measure IFN expression. They also developed a computational model to simulate the effects of DVGs on IFN feedback and calibrated it using existing infection data.
analysis_en.main_results: The model suggests that cumulative IFN exposure, rather than instantaneous levels, shapes further IFN induction. DVGs are shown to trigger IFN activation while also contributing to negative feedback, which can suppress innate immune responses in neighboring cells.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings reveal a dual role of DVGs in both activating and suppressing IFN responses, offering a novel mechanism for how viruses can evade immune responses. This explains two key observations: IFN levels can decline while virus levels rise, and pandemic viruses can replicate through local immune suppression.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide insights into the complex interplay between DVGs and the host immune system, which could inform strategies for therapeutic interventions targeting viral RNA populations to optimize antiviral responses.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on in vitro and in vivo data, which may limit generalizability. However, the model is calibrated on published data, and the evidence is supported by both experimental and computational approaches, giving it a moderate confidence level.

papers.title_zh: 有缺陷的病毒 基因组 揭示了 I 型干扰素动力学的历史依赖性自我调节
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Type I interferons (IFN) help clear a viral infection, but IFN levels can then decline to reset the antiviral state and avoid innate immune dysregulation. Such dysregulation can occur following infection with highly pathogenic and pandemic RNA viruses, such as H5N1 influenza A viruses or SARS-CoV-2. In spite of the strong innate immune response that these viruses induce, pandemic viruses replicate and spread successfully, suggesting that they can circumvent the effects of IFN. Innate immune activation is triggered when host cells detect viral RNA, especially defective viral genomes (DVGs). A strong IFN response (e.g. to DVGs or a highly immunogenic wild-type infection) must then decline through negative feedback involving the IFN receptor. How DVGs modulate this feedback remains poorly understood. To quantify positive and negative IFN regulation, we first performed in vitro experiments combining different doses of viral RNA and exogenous IFN, and measured subsequent IFN expression. We next developed an in vivo Bayesian computational model that captures the impact of influenza virus DVGs on both positive and negative IFN feedback. Competition between DVGs and virus is also considered. Finally, we calibrated this model on published in vitro and in vivo influenza virus infection data. Our model suggests that the cumulative IFN exposure of a host cell, rather than the instantaneous IFN level, shapes further IFN induction; this gives DVGs a dual role: beyond triggering IFN induction, they can also lower it through negative feedback. Our model further predicts that these effects are important locally, shaping the spatial dynamics of the response, allowing suppression of innate immune responses in neighbouring, uninfected cells. Through this model, we can explain two important biological observations: i) IFN levels can decline while virus and DVG levels continue to rise in tissue culture and mouse infections; and ii) pandemic viruses that produce high levels of immunogenic RNA molecules can successfully replicate through local innate immune suppression. Overall, we propose that heterogeneity within viral populations (including DVGs and other noncanonical viral RNAs) can modulate positive and negative feedback loops and shape infection outcomes. More broadly, our work may support studies into the therapeutic use of these viral RNA populations. Author summary Humans and animals have to fight influenza virus and other infections without inducing immunopathology. After detection of an infection, the innate immune system produces type I interferon (IFN), a signal that starts a protective response. However, high levels of IFN and prolonged IFN expression can cause damage to tissues and worsen disease. Negative feedback is one route by which IFN production can stop, but its activation during viral infection remains poorly understood. A central question is why viruses can continue to replicate and spread despite a strong IFN response. We here investigated why IFN levels can begin to decline while virus levels continue to rise during influenza virus infection. This decline is most pronounced when the virus produces large amounts of defective viral genomes (DVGs). These defective genomes arise naturally during viral replication and are produced by many RNA viruses, including SARS-CoV-2, Ebola virus, and measles virus. Using cell-culture experiments, computational modelling, and fitting of our model to cell-culture and mouse data, we find that defective genomes contribute to both IFN activation and its negative feedback. Both the experiments and model support a mechanism in which IFN accumulation during infection suppresses its own production, and that this suppression can start earlier under strong DVG stimulation. At the local level, this can allow viral spread to continue even while overall IFN levels remain high. Overall, our findings reveal an additional level of interplay between defective viral genomes and the host innate immune system. They also suggest that the potential therapeutic use of defective genomes must be carefully calibrated to achieve an optimal antiviral response.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 I 型干扰素 (IFN) 有助于清除病毒感染,但 IFN 水平可能会下降,从而重置 抗病毒药物 状态并避免先天免疫失调。这种失调可能发生在感染高致病性和大流行性 RNA 病毒(例如 H5N1 甲型流感病毒或 SARS-CoV-2)后。尽管这些病毒诱导出强大的先天 免疫应答,但大流行病毒仍能成功复制和传播,这表明它们可以规避 IFN 的影响。当 宿主 细胞检测到病毒 RNA,尤其是有缺陷的病毒 基因组 (DVG) 时,会触发先天免疫激活。然后,强烈的 IFN 反应(例如对 DVG 或高免疫原性野生型感染)必须通过涉及 IFN 受体的负反馈而减弱。DVG 如何调节这种反馈仍然知之甚少。为了量化IFN的正向和负向调节,我们首先结合不同剂量的病毒RNA和外源IFN进行体外实验,并测量随后的IFN表达。接下来,我们开发了一种体内贝叶斯计算模型,该模型可以捕获流感病毒 DVG 对 IFN 正反馈和负反馈的影响。还考虑了 DVG 和病毒之间的竞争。最后,我们根据已发表的体外和体内流感病毒感染数据校准了该模型。我们的模型表明,宿主 细胞的累积 IFN 暴露,而不是瞬时 IFN 水平,决定了进一步的 IFN 诱导;这赋予 DVG 双重作用:除了触发 IFN 诱导之外,它们还可以通过负反馈降低 IFN 诱导。我们的模型进一步预测这些效应在局部很重要,塑造了反应的空间动态,从而抑制邻近未感染细胞中的先天 免疫应答。通过这个模型,我们可以解释两个重要的生物学观察结果:i)在组织培养和小鼠感染中,IFN 水平可能下降,而病毒和 DVG 水平继续上升;ii) 产生高水平免疫原性 RNA 分子的大流行病毒可以通过局部先天免疫抑制成功复制。总体而言,我们认为病毒群体内的异质性(包括 DVG 和其他非典型病毒 RNA)可以调节正反馈环和负反馈环并塑造感染结果。更广泛地说,我们的工作可能支持这些病毒 RNA 群体的治疗用途的研究。作者摘要 人类和动物必须在不引发免疫病理学的情况下对抗流感病毒和其他感染。检测到感染后,先天免疫系统会产生 I 型干扰素 (IFN),这是一种启动保护性反应的信号。然而,高水平的干扰素和延长的干扰素表达会导致组织损伤并使疾病恶化。负反馈是干扰素产生停止的一种途径,但其在病毒感染期间的激活仍知之甚少。一个核心问题是,为什么尽管有强烈的干扰素反应,病毒仍能继续复制和传播。我们在这里研究了为什么在流感病毒感染期间,干扰素水平会开始下降,而病毒水平继续上升。当病毒产生大量有缺陷的病毒 基因组 (DVG) 时,这种下降最为明显。这些有缺陷的 基因组 在病毒复制过程中自然出现,由许多 RNA 病毒产生,包括 SARS-CoV-2、埃博拉病毒和麻疹病毒。通过细胞培养实验、计算建模以及将我们的模型与细胞培养和小鼠数据进行拟合,我们发现有缺陷的 基因组 会导致 IFN 激活及其负反馈。实验和模型都支持感染过程中 IFN 积累抑制其自身产生的机制,并且这种抑制可以在强 DVG 刺激下更早开始。在地方层面,即使总体干扰素水平仍然很高,这也可能导致病毒继续传播。总体而言,我们的研究结果揭示了有缺陷的病毒 基因组 和 宿主 先天免疫系统之间的额外相互作用。他们还建议,必须仔细校准有缺陷的 基因组 的潜在治疗用途,以实现最佳的 抗病毒药物 反应。

papers.title: Influenza thermostability
papers.abstract: Even prior to the advent of germ theory in the 19th century, disease inflicted by viruses and the scale at which this could occur was recognised and feared, if not understood. Some viruses, such as influenza A virus (IAV), have been the cause of great morbidity and mortality throughout history. Their ability to transmit between hosts is key to their pandemic potential. This is not trivial, requiring the virus to surmount a veritable obstacle course of environmental insults before reaching safe harbour; a compatible host organism. Surprisingly, this area is relatively unstudied, with a dearth of clarity on how this occurs, and perhaps most importantly, the bounds of virus viability. Temperature is one of the key environmental factors of viral stability. Exploited as a means of pathogen eradication throughout history, likely predating any concept of micro-organisms, it remains in use today, particularly in the food and healthcare industry, e.g pasteurisation. Fortunately this process remains effective against IAV, reassuring when avian influenza spread to dairy cattle. Understanding the mechanism of viral inactivation due to heat would allow us to improve the efficacy of disinfection via this method and likely have other applications, for example in vaccine stability. This study is an effort to disentangle the complex environmental factors by focusing on thermostability in bulk solution. It found that IAV infectivity demonstrated first-order exponential decay below 50 °C, indicating a non-cooperative inactivation mechanism. Arrhenius behaviour between two linear regimes (above and below 40 °C) suggest there are different dominant inactivation pathways separated by temperature. The 40-50 °C regime was further elucidated in view of its implications on disinfection. Thermodynamic analysis suggests a process consistent with protein unfolding, particularly implicating the viral haemagglutinin (HA). Alternative inactivation mechanisms such as virion rupture, aggregation or failure of receptor binding were excluded. Modifications to HA, such as amino-acid substitution or prevention of cleavage, resulted in an increased inactivation rate, and alterations to thermodynamic parameters. Lowering the pH had a similar effect on rate, but also lowered the energy barrier for viral inactivation, hinting at a catalytic process. A 3-state mathematical model of HA conformational change was able to recapitulate experimental findings at both low and neutral pH, suggesting the transitions are key to the underlying mechanism. Although the precise point of failure remains unclear, potential causes include insertion of the HA fusion peptide into an inappropriate target membrane. This work presents areas for further investigation and a way to translate these methods and approach to identify inactivation mechanisms in other pathogens.

Surprisingly, this area is relatively unstudied, with a dearth of clarity on how this occurs, and perhaps most importantly, the bounds of virus viability. Temperature is one of the key environmental factors of viral stability. Exploited as a means of pathogen eradication throughout history, likely predating any concept of micro-organisms, it remains in use today, particularly in the food and healthcare industry, e.g pasteurisation. Fortunately this process remains effective against IAV, reassuring when avian influenza spread to dairy cattle. Understanding the mechanism of viral inactivation due to heat would allow us to improve the efficacy of disinfection via this method and likely have other applications, for example in vaccine stability. This study is an effort to disentangle the complex environmental factors by focusing on thermostability in bulk solution. It found that IAV infectivity demonstrated first-order exponential decay below 50 °C, indicating a non-cooperative inactivation mechanism. Arrhenius behaviour between two linear regimes (above and below 40 °C) suggest there are different dominant inactivation pathways separated by temperature. The 40-50 °C regime was further elucidated in view of its implications on disinfection. Thermodynamic analysis suggests a process consistent with protein unfolding, particularly implicating the viral haemagglutinin (HA). Alternative inactivation mechanisms such as virion rupture, aggregation or failure of receptor binding were excluded. Modifications to HA, such as amino-acid substitution or prevention of cleavage, resulted in an increased inactivation rate, and alterations to thermodynamic parameters. Lowering the pH had a similar effect on rate, but also lowered the energy barrier for viral inactivation, hinting at a catalytic process. A 3-state mathematical model of HA conformational change was able to recapitulate experimental findings at both low and neutral pH, suggesting the transitions are key to the underlying mechanism. Although the precise point of failure remains unclear, potential causes include insertion of the HA fusion peptide into an inappropriate target membrane. This work presents areas for further investigation and a way to translate these methods and approach to identify inactivation mechanisms in other pathogens.

papers.title: Diagnóstico de hemoparásitos, enteroparásitos y virus de importancia zoonótica en poblaciones urbanas de Columba livia en Colombia
papers.abstract: Domestic pigeons (Columba livia) are reservoirs of several infectious agents and represent a risk to public health. In Colombia, this introduced species is common in urban areas, where several microbiological studies have been conducted. However, its role in circulating West Nile virus (WNV) and avian influenza (AI) remains unknown. This study aimed to evaluate the presence of enteroparasites, haemoparasites, and the detection of WNV and AI in feral pigeons captured in Bogotá, Arauca and Aguazul. Faecal samples, blood samples, oral and cloacal swabs were collected from 48 individuals. Parasitological analyses included fresh examination for gastrointestinal parasites and Giemsa staining for haemoparasites. RT-qPCR was used to detect the virus using TaqMan and SYBR-Green. The results indicate the presence of Haemoproteus columbae, together with the presence of several endoparasites, including Eimeria and Blastocystis, among others, in Arauca and Bogota. We discuss the results of molecular testing for potentially zoonotic viruses. Continued active surveillance in synanthropic species such as this one is essential to establish prevention and control strategies in urban contexts, where frequent contact between humans and pigeons may facilitate the transmission of microorganisms.

In Colombia, this introduced species is common in urban areas, where several microbiological studies have been conducted. However, its role in circulating West Nile virus (WNV) and avian influenza (AI) remains unknown. This study aimed to evaluate the presence of enteroparasites, haemoparasites, and the detection of WNV and AI in feral pigeons captured in Bogotá, Arauca and Aguazul. Faecal samples, blood samples, oral and cloacal swabs were collected from 48 individuals. Parasitological analyses included fresh examination for gastrointestinal parasites and Giemsa staining for haemoparasites. RT-qPCR was used to detect the virus using TaqMan and SYBR-Green. The results indicate the presence of Haemoproteus columbae, together with the presence of several endoparasites, including Eimeria and Blastocystis, among others, in Arauca and Bogota. We discuss the results of molecular testing for potentially zoonotic viruses. Continued active surveillance in synanthropic species such as this one is essential to establish prevention and control strategies in urban contexts, where frequent contact between humans and pigeons may facilitate the transmission of microorganisms.

papers.title: Breaking the channel barrier: same-fluorescence, different-Tm probe strategy enables seven-target respiratory virus detection on a six-channel PCR platform within 20 minutes.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Respiratory pathogens with overlapping symptoms-including SARS-CoV-2, influenza A/B, H5/H7/H10 avian influenza, and RSV-co-circulate and co-infect, demanding rapid multiplex screening at points of care. Conventional multiplex real-time PCR is constrained by hardware channel capacity (≤6), making it difficult to detect seven targets while distinguishing influenza A and B in a single tube. This work addresses the contradiction between high-order multiplexing and limited fluorescence channels without sacrificing speed or sensitivity. RESULTS We developed a six-channel ultra-fast PCR platform detecting seven respiratory viruses in a single tube within 20 min, using a same-fluorescence, different-Tm probe strategy. Influenza A and B share the FAM channel yet generate distinct melting peaks (∼12 °C difference, 84.8 °C vs. 72.3 °C), enabling accurate typing via melting curve analysis. Primers, probes, and enzymes are pre-embedded as lyophilized beads in sealed cartridges for fully automated sample-to-result operation. The assay achieved 100% detection at 5 copies/test for all targets, linearity (R2 > 0.95) across 5-105 copies/test, 90-110% efficiencies, and no cross-reactivity against 39 non-target pathogens. Cartridges remained stable for 12 months at 25 °C. Validation on 271 clinical specimens showed 100% agreement with sequencing-verified single-plex qPCR. SIGNIFICANCE AND NOVELTY This work provides the first integration of melting-curve-based same-channel multiplexing with lyophilized cartridge technology on an ultra-fast PCR platform. By overcoming channel limitations while maintaining speed and sensitivity, the system offers a practical, field-deployable screening tool for decentralized respiratory pathogen detection in resource-limited settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在解决使用有限数量的 PCR 通道同时保持速度和灵敏度来检测具有重叠症状的多种呼吸道病原体(包括 禽流感 A 病毒)的挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究开发了一种六通道超快速 PCR 平台,能够在 20 分钟内在单管中检测​​包括 禽流感 A 病毒在内的 7 种呼吸道病毒。它使用 271 个临床样本验证了该平台。
elements_zh.methods: 该平台采用相同荧光、不同Tm探针策略,将引物、探针和酶预先嵌入密封盒中,以实现全自动样品到结果操作。该测定的检测灵敏度、线性、效率和交叉反应性均经过验证。
elements_zh.main_results: 该检测在 5 个拷贝/测试中对所有目标实现了 100% 检测,在 5-105 个拷贝/测试中实现了线性 (R2 > 0.95),效率为 90-110%,并且与 39 种非目标病原体没有交叉反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究引入了一种新颖的方法,该方法将基于熔解曲线的同通道多重检测与冻干盒技术相结合,能够在六通道 PCR 平台上检测七种呼吸道病毒,而不会影响速度或灵敏度。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该系统提供了一种实用的、可现场部署的筛查工具,用于分散式呼吸道病原体检测,特别适用于资源有限的环境中,用于识别 禽流感 A 病毒和其他共同传播的病原体。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于摘要证据,研究结果基于 271 个临床样本的验证。由于缺乏详细的统计分析或长期现场性能数据,证据强度中等。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of detecting multiple respiratory pathogens, including avian influenza A viruses, with overlapping symptoms, using a limited number of PCR channels while maintaining speed and sensitivity.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study developed a six-channel ultra-fast PCR platform capable of detecting seven respiratory viruses, including avian influenza A viruses, in a single tube within 20 minutes. It validated the platform using 271 clinical specimens.
analysis_en.methods: The platform uses a same-fluorescence, different-Tm probe strategy, with primers, probes, and enzymes pre-embedded in sealed cartridges for fully automated sample-to-result operation. The assay was validated for detection sensitivity, linearity, efficiency, and cross-reactivity.
analysis_en.main_results: The assay achieved 100% detection at 5 copies/test for all targets, linearity (R2 > 0.95) across 5-105 copies/test, 90-110% efficiencies, and no cross-reactivity against 39 non-target pathogens.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The study introduced a novel approach that integrates melting-curve-based same-channel multiplexing with lyophilized cartridge technology, enabling the detection of seven respiratory viruses on a six-channel PCR platform without compromising speed or sensitivity.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The system provides a practical, field-deployable screening tool for decentralized respiratory pathogen detection, particularly useful in resource-limited settings for identifying avian influenza A viruses and other co-circulating pathogens.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-only evidence, and the findings are based on validation with 271 clinical specimens. The evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of detailed statistical analysis or long-term field performance data.

papers.title_zh: 打破通道障碍:同荧光、不同Tm探针策略可在20分钟内在六通道PCR平台上实现七靶标呼吸道病毒检测。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND Respiratory pathogens with overlapping symptoms-including SARS-CoV-2, influenza A/B, H5/H7/H10 avian influenza, and RSV-co-circulate and co-infect, demanding rapid multiplex screening at points of care. Conventional multiplex real-time PCR is constrained by hardware channel capacity (≤6), making it difficult to detect seven targets while distinguishing influenza A and B in a single tube. This work addresses the contradiction between high-order multiplexing and limited fluorescence channels without sacrificing speed or sensitivity. RESULTS We developed a six-channel ultra-fast PCR platform detecting seven respiratory viruses in a single tube within 20 min, using a same-fluorescence, different-Tm probe strategy. Influenza A and B share the FAM channel yet generate distinct melting peaks (∼12 °C difference, 84.8 °C vs. 72.3 °C), enabling accurate typing via melting curve analysis. Primers, probes, and enzymes are pre-embedded as lyophilized beads in sealed cartridges for fully automated sample-to-result operation. The assay achieved 100% detection at 5 copies/test for all targets, linearity (R2 > 0.95) across 5-105 copies/test, 90-110% efficiencies, and no cross-reactivity against 39 non-target pathogens. Cartridges remained stable for 12 months at 25 °C. Validation on 271 clinical specimens showed 100% agreement with sequencing-verified single-plex qPCR. SIGNIFICANCE AND NOVELTY This work provides the first integration of melting-curve-based same-channel multiplexing with lyophilized cartridge technology on an ultra-fast PCR platform. By overcoming channel limitations while maintaining speed and sensitivity, the system offers a practical, field-deployable screening tool for decentralized respiratory pathogen detection in resource-limited settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 具有重叠症状的呼吸道病原体(包括 SARS-CoV-2、甲型/乙型流感、H5/H7/H10 禽流感 和 RSV)共同循环和共同感染,需要在护理点进行快速多重筛查。传统多重实时PCR受硬件通道容量(≤6)的限制,难以在单管中检测​​7个靶标并区分甲型和乙型流感。这项工作在不牺牲速度或灵敏度的情况下解决了高阶多重和有限荧光通道之间的矛盾。结果我们开发了一个六通道超快速 PCR 平台,使用相同荧光、不同 Tm 探针策略,可在 20 分钟内检测单管中的七种呼吸道病毒。甲型流感和乙型流感共享 FAM 通道,但会产生不同的熔解峰(~12 °C 差异,84.8 °C 与 72.3 °C),从而可以通过熔解曲线分析进行准确分型。引物、探针和酶以冻干珠的形式预先嵌入密封盒中,以实现全自动样品到结果操作。该检测在 5 个拷贝/测试中对所有目标实现了 100% 检测,在 5-105 个拷贝/测试中实现了线性 (R2 > 0.95),效率为 90-110%,并且与 39 种非目标病原体没有交叉反应。墨盒在 25 °C 下可保持稳定 12 个月。对 271 个临床样本的验证显示与测序验证的单重 qPCR 100% 一致。意义和新颖性 这项工作首次将基于熔解曲线的同通道多重技术与冻干柱技术在超快速 PCR 平台上集成。通过克服通道限制,同时保持速度和灵敏度,该系统提供了一种实用的、可现场部署的筛查工具,用于在资源有限的环境中进行分散的呼吸道病原体检测。
